items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: in fact, he wrote me from Spain and I sent him a shirt about seven, eight years ago.

ctx.x: And then there was a good band in Savannah. It was called Al Curren and the Snappy Six. That was a real good band that played around Savannah. And there

was a trombone player that played -- I can't think of his name but he went to Europe later. Who played -- I'll think of his name and tell you later, but I can't think of it now. But he played -- in fact, he wrote me from Spain and I sent him a shirt about seven, eight years ago. Aloha shirt to Spain. But he played in -- around New York with Red Allen and quite a few bands. I'll tell you his name when I think of it. I can't think of it right now.
Was there anyone else who came out of Savannah that stayed in music and made any kind of a name?
